title: DS-160 Photo Upload Problems: File Size & Format Checklist
metaDescription: Troubleshoot a DS-160 photo file: JPEG format, pixel dimensions, file size and a free browser file check. Separate technical upload errors from photo acceptance.
content:
Use this checklist when the application reports a photo upload problem. Keep the exact error message and your original image. A file-format check and a photograph assessment solve different problems.

Start with the free file check

Check your DS-160 photo file for JPEG format, square dimensions and file size. This small check runs in your browser and does not upload your photo.

Read the error before changing the image

  • File type: export as JPEG. Changing a PNG filename to .jpg does not convert it.
  • Dimensions: inspect the pixel width and height. A square print layout is not the same as the single digital photo.
  • File size: inspect the actual saved file, not the thumbnail shown by your photo app.
  • Image quality: return to the original. Repeated screenshots and compression can lose detail.

Confirm the current digital requirements

The State Department specifies a square JPEG from 600×600 to 1200×1200 pixels, at most 240 kB, in 24-bit sRGB, with a compression ratio no greater than 20:1. Our file check covers format, dimensions and bytes; it does not verify colour profile, compression ratio or photographic suitability.

Read the official digital image requirements. Follow the instructions shown by your application and consulate if they request additional documents or prints.

If the basic file checks pass

Passing these checks does not confirm face alignment, background, lighting or acceptance. Compare your photograph with the official visa photo guidance. For an unclear portal error, follow the application’s help instructions rather than repeatedly altering your appearance.

Need preparation rather than troubleshooting?

Read the US visa photo guide, then preview the US visa preset if appropriate. Previewing is free; prepared downloads are paid. Neither payment nor successful upload guarantees acceptance.
